findings.text: _lane_document_object re-adds the json.loads plus try/except copy the done-when asked to remove and reads the lane file a second time, so the report at line 777 and the admission at line 778 can describe two different document vintages; read_lane_admission takes a parsed object only, so the copy-free form needs an accessor beside read_lane_admission in reckon/crew/lane_document.py, outside this node's fence.
ready_set_view is called with no limit, so it pages its ready rows at DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE (25) and every ready-idle row past the first page silently contributes no idle owner to the board.

The ready-idle join is skipped whenever project is None or '*', so the default workstation-scope crew(view=directory) read lists no run-less coordinator at all; ready_idle_join names the limitation but the case the section exists to close is absent from the view's default answer.

The binding verdict is asserted only for the running run, so a regression that hardcodes binding True for every held path passes; the test never asserts the queued run's claim reads as disregarded, which is the case claim_disposition at reckon/crew/node.py:1601 exists to answer.

item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it declares the gate, the negative control, both adjacent arms and an outside_scope note on the per-session admission-row lookup.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Read the four declared write paths; every path in the two commits sits inside them and no figure directory was written.
